newsitem.title: USA: Paramount names Manning as president of production.
newsitem.headline: Paramount names Manning as president of production.

text.p: Paramount Pictures Thursday promoted Michelle Manning to president of production for Paramount Motion Pictures Group.
Manning replaces John Goldwyn, who held the job for six years before being promoted to president of Paramount Motion Pictures Group in March.
Manning will be responsible for overseeing the development and production of Paramount's motion pictures and will report directly to Goldwyn.
Manning joined Paramount in 1991, having worked as a producer, director and studio executive. She was promoted to executive vice president of production in 1993.
Among the Paramount films Manning has overseen are "Forrest Gump," "Primal Fear," "Clueless" and "The Firm." Paramount is a unit of Viacom Inc.
